lines.description:
SECOND PAYMENT — 30% OF THE CONTRACT VALUE
Second instalment against our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ145/2026 for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of one (1) chiller room and one (1) freezer room, each 3.00 x 3.00 x 2.40 m internal, falling due after installation of the sandwich panel and before delivery of the condensing units.
The panel stage comprises, to BOTH rooms: 100 mm PUF insulated sandwich panel to walls and ceiling with all aluminium coving, corner angles, silicone sealing, fasteners and accessories; the insulated floor system of 100 mm PUF floor panel with 18 mm marine plywood and 1.5 mm MS chequered plate, 9.00 sqm to each room; and two (2) hinged cold room doors 900 x 1900 mm complete with heated frames, gaskets and hardware — one to the chiller room and one to the freezer room.
Contract value QAR 52,000.00 — this invoice covers the second instalment of 30%.

notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 52,000.00. Received: the 50% advance of QAR 26,000.00 in cash on 14-11-2026 against INV-305/2026, receipted under RCT-307/2026, with our thanks. This invoice: the second instalment of 30%, QAR 15,600.00. Remaining after this invoice: QAR 10,400.00, being the 20% payable at handover.

AGREED PAYMENT SCHEDULE. 50% advance QAR 26,000.00; 30% QAR 15,600.00 after installation of the sandwich panel and before delivery of the condensing units; and 20% QAR 10,400.00 at handover. This schedule replaces the stages printed in our quotation and is the schedule on which both of us have proceeded since 12-11-2026.

WHAT THIS PAYMENT RELEASES. Under the schedule agreed between us this instalment falls due on the panel stage and BEFORE the condensing units are delivered to site. On receipt the two condensing units — one (1) 2 HP for the chiller room and one (1) 2.5 HP for the freezer room, each with its matching evaporating unit on R404A — together with the copper piping, Armaflex insulation, expansion valves, filter driers, sight glasses, the solenoid valve, electric defrost and heated drain line to the freezer, the digital control panels, the internal LED lighting, the door frame heaters and the electrical works, are released for delivery and installation, followed by testing, commissioning and handover.

Payment due on presentation of this invoice. Payment may be made in cash, or by cheque or bank transfer to the account shown above; cheques to be crossed "A/C Payee Only" and drawn strictly in favour of the account name given, which is THE NEW DOHA KITCHEN EQUIPMENT SERVICES W.L.L., with no word between Equipment and Services. Kindly quote invoice INV-325/2026 as the reference. Where payment is made in cash, kindly obtain our numbered receipt at the time.

WARRANTY: twelve (12) months on the cold room panels, the doors, the insulated floors and our workmanship from the date of handover, and twelve (12) months on the condensing units, the evaporating units, the electrical components and the controls from the date of commissioning. Excludes damage from misuse, power surge, improper voltage, water ingress, unauthorised modification, operation outside the design condition or the absence of routine maintenance.
This invoice is issued against our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ145/2026 and is subject to its terms. We thank you for the order and for the prompt settlement of the advance.
